other_conditions: Fisherman engaged in selling and marketing fish
Fisherman engaged in fishing at sea with a canoe
Fisherman engaged in fishing at sea with a mechanized fishing vessel with up to 6‑cylinder engines
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 75 % of the cost of insulated fish boxes, with maximum subsidy limits of ₹1,500 for a 50 L box, ₹7,000 for 100 L and 220 L boxes, and ₹15,000 for 220 L and 400 L boxes depending on the fisherman's activity.
